slice: H5-B1 local checkpoint and isolated restore module
purpose: Implement the offline checkpoint/restore module: strict BackupBundle manifests, control SQLite online backup capture with injected Goal Session/memory/shared-object ports, real-byte bundle verification, staging interruption handling, last-good rules, and isolated-root maintenance/disarmed restore with recovery locks, deletion/authorization barriers and unknown-effect preservation.

implementation.bundle: two-level BackupBundle/component manifests with strict closed schemas; ready requires four complete components, actual watermarks/revisions, per-file hashes, SQLite quick_check/foreign_key_check, goal-log tail/projection digests and reference closures; failed/incomplete never publish and never replace last-good; cross-component common section is fixed false (reconcileRequired true)
implementation.capture: node:sqlite backup into staging, Goal Session read-only injected port copy+verify, memory export port, shared-object closure, atomic publish only after verifyBundleDirectory re-reads the real bytes
implementation.restore: isolated target root only, exclusive recovery lock + maintenance/disarmed, re-verify after copy, deletion/authorization barrier and tombstone replay, preserved unknown effects (no automatic replay), new installationGeneration/hostEpoch recorded with verifiedByHost=false, stops at not-activated
boundaries: no live data root or native Session access
no independent fault domain or V27
